encoding.notes: Literal original offsets Joy=11f8, Jup=1202, Jdown=120c, Jleft=1218, Jright=1224, Fire=1232, Print=0476 and independent physical-line/payload bytes. No production name table or encoder.

evidence.notes: Neutral headless input gives zero mask/booleans. Separate raw-offset tests inject masks on both ports and verify pressed results of -1. Browser mapping/native API checks and original menu replay are separate evidence; no physical controller or Amiga execution capture.
